python3 -c '
import subprocess, re, collections
def run(args, **kw):
    return subprocess.run(args, cwd="/opt/weather-pipeline/repo", capture_output=True, text=True, **kw)

reflog = run(["git","reflog","show","--date=iso","HEAD"]).stdout.strip().splitlines()
print(f"Total reflog entries (HEAD only): {len(reflog)}")

cats = collections.Counter()
per_day = collections.Counter()
date_re = re.compile(r"\{(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})")
for line in reflog:
    if "rebase (start)" in line: cats["rebase(start)"] += 1
    elif "rebase (pick)" in line: cats["rebase(pick)"] += 1
    elif "rebase (finish)" in line: cats["rebase(finish)"] += 1
    elif "rebase" in line: cats["rebase(other)"] += 1
    elif "reset:" in line: cats["reset"] += 1
    elif "checkout:" in line: cats["checkout"] += 1
    elif "commit (amend)" in line: cats["commit(amend)"] += 1
    elif "commit:" in line: cats["commit"] += 1
    elif "pull" in line: cats["pull"] += 1
    elif "clone" in line: cats["clone"] += 1
    else: cats["other"] += 1
    m = date_re.search(line)
    if m:
        per_day[m.group(1)] += 1

print("\nBy category:")
for k, v in cats.most_common():
    print(f"  {k:20s} {v}")
print("\nBy day:")
for d in sorted(per_day):
    print(f"  {d}: {per_day[d]}")
print(f"\n[D] rebase(finish) events (orphan-by-rebase count): {cats.get('"'"'rebase(finish)'"'"',0)}")
'
